problem_statement: Fix astropy.io.ascii.qdp so QDP is case-insensitive. Make exactly these two minimal production changes in astropy/io/ascii/qdp.py: change re.compile(_type_re) to re.compile(_type_re, re.IGNORECASE), and change the masked-token comparison if v == "NO": to if v.upper() == "NO":. Do not change any regex definitions, delimiter handling, fill_values, tests, documentation, or other files. The final patch must contain exactly astropy/io/ascii/qdp.py and exactly those two source edits.
